HQNapalmAirstrike.wav.speaker: Sarge
HQNapalmAirstrike.wav.value_ch: 总部，我需要凝固汽油弹。

HQ_BigHead.wav.speaker: HQ_Command
HQ_BigHead.wav.value_en: Sarge, we have reports that the aliens are being led by a larger alien with a big head. Your orders are to take this alien commander out of the picture so we can get the civilian convoy through. Good luck. HQ out.
HQ_BigHead.wav.value_ch: 中士，据报外星人由一只大脑袋的大个子外星人率领。你的任务是除掉这个外星指挥官，好让平民车队通过。祝好运。总部完毕。

HQ_BootCamp.wav.speaker: HQ_Command
HQ_BootCamp.wav.value_en: Welcome to Boot Camp, Sarge. Here you will learn the tools to help you defeat the Tan and stay in one piece. Make sure to follow the signs and do exactly what they tell you to do. Go for it. HQ out.
HQ_BootCamp.wav.value_ch: 欢迎来到新兵营，中士。在这里你将学会击败黄军的本领，还能全身而退。务必跟着路标走，指示让你做什么就做什么。放手干吧。总部完毕。

HQ_CivilianDestination.wav.speaker: HQ_Command
HQ_CivilianDestination.wav.value_en: Good job eliminating that alien commander. Now that the path is cleared, you can escort the civilian convoy to their final destination. HQ, out.
HQ_CivilianDestination.wav.value_ch: 干得漂亮，解决了那个外星指挥官。既然路已打通，你可以护送平民车队前往终点了。总部完毕。

HQ_CivilianSafe.wav.speaker: HQ_Command
HQ_CivilianSafe.wav.value_en: The civilians are finally safe. Thanks to you, Sarge.
HQ_CivilianSafe.wav.value_ch: 平民终于安全了。多亏了你，中士。

HQ_Civilian_Convoy.wav.speaker: HQ_Command
HQ_Civilian_Convoy.wav.value_en: Good work on saving those civilians, Sarge. Unfortunately, we don't have enough manpower to defend this area. You'll have to move the civilians to a safer location before more of those aliens attack. HQ out.
HQ_Civilian_Convoy.wav.value_ch: 救出那些平民干得不错，中士。可惜我们兵力不足以防守此地。在更多外星人来袭前，你得把平民转移到更安全的地方。总部完毕。

HQ_Congratulations.wav.speaker: HQ_Command
HQ_Congratulations.wav.value_en: Congratulations, Sarge. Report back to HQ for your first assignment.
HQ_Congratulations.wav.value_ch: 恭喜，中士。回总部报到，领取你的第一项任务。

HQ_FoxTrot.wav.speaker: HQ_Command
HQ_FoxTrot.wav.value_en: Sarge, escort the civilian convoy to Sector Foxtrot Whiskey 1. Secure a safe position and report back to us when your mission is successful. HQ, out.
HQ_FoxTrot.wav.value_ch: 中士，护送平民车队前往狐步威士忌目标点。占据安全位置，任务达成后向我们报告。总部完毕。

HQ_Goodwork.wav.speaker: HQ_Command
HQ_Goodwork.wav.value_en: Good work, Sarge. The area is secure.
HQ_Goodwork.wav.value_ch: 干得好，中士。这片区域安全了。

HQ_INTO_UFO.wav.speaker: HQ_Command
HQ_INTO_UFO.wav.value_en: Sarge, this is the area where the UFO landed. We think Plastro has an alliance with something out of this world. We have suspicions that there is more to it than just that ship. Go investigate and try to sneak your way inside the UFO. HQ out.
HQ_INTO_UFO.wav.value_ch: 中士，这里是飞碟降落的区域。我们认为普拉斯托和外星势力结了盟。我们怀疑背后的东西不止那艘船。去调查，想办法潜入飞碟内部。总部完毕。

HQ_Protectourpeople.wav.speaker: HQ_Command
HQ_Protectourpeople.wav.value_en: Sarge, those aliens found another way in. They're rumored to be moving in on the town in your area. You are the only hope for the civilians in this region. Go in, or have a unit go inside each house and order the people living there to run to the old vehicle depot on the south. Let's try and get as many civilians out as possible. Sarge, you're holding all the cards. Good luck. HQ out.
HQ_Protectourpeople.wav.value_ch: 中士，那些外星人找到了另一条路进来。听说他们正逼近你那片区域的城镇。你是这地带平民唯一的希望。亲自进去，或者派兵挨家挨户通知居民逃往南边的旧车场。尽量多撤出平民。中士，主动权在你手里。祝好运。总部完毕。

HQ_RescueHostages.wav.speaker: HQ_Command
HQ_RescueHostages.wav.value_en: Sarge, we found out where your men are being held. Recon can't tell if your men are dead or alive, but they do know your guys are just east of you. There were a lot more TAN in the area than we thought, so I guess the helicopter drop wasn't the best planned out operation. In any case, we're glad you made it out okay. Your guys are tough, and I'm sure they're making TAN's life miserable. Now, go get those guys and clear out the area of any remaining TAN. HQ out.
HQ_RescueHostages.wav.value_ch: 中士，我们查明了你的人被关在哪里。侦察兵分不清他们是死是活，但确认他们就在你东边。那一带黄军比预想的多得多，看来直升机空投这招计划得不太妙。不管怎样，你活着出来就好。你的人很硬气，肯定把黄军折腾得够呛。现在去把他们救出来，清掉残敌。总部完毕。

HQ_SecretBase.wav.speaker: HQ_Command
HQ_SecretBase.wav.value_en: Sarge, we now know where all those tan are coming from. There seems to be a tan base somewhere in this area. Find and destroy that base. HQ out.
HQ_SecretBase.wav.value_ch: 中士，我们现在知道那帮黄军从哪来了。这片区域某处似乎有个黄军基地。找到并摧毁它。总部完毕。

HQ_base_history.wav.speaker: HQ_Command
HQ_base_history.wav.value_en: Good work, Sarge. Tan's base is history.
HQ_base_history.wav.value_ch: 干得好，中士。黄军基地已成历史。

HQ_distress_signal.wav.speaker: HQ_Command
HQ_distress_signal.wav.value_en: Sarge, we intercepted that message from the walkie-talkie, and it's from someone named Tina Tomorrow. She says she's trapped and needs assistance. She seems to think that unless someone helps her take out some force field generators, the aliens will be here shortly. Aliens? Find her, and help her deactivate the three force field generators so you can both get out of there. HQ out.
HQ_distress_signal.wav.value_ch: 中士，我们截获了那条对讲机讯息，发信人叫蒂娜·图莫罗。她说自己被困，需要救援。她认为除非有人帮她关掉几台力场发生器，外星人马上就会杀到。外星人？找到她，帮她关闭那三台力场发生器，你们俩才能脱身。总部完毕。

HQ_strategic.wav.speaker: HQ_Command
HQ_strategic.wav.value_en: Sarge, take these tanks and secure the three indicated strategic points. By doing so, Tina and her troopers will be able to beam in and reveal why this area seems so important. Make sure Tina succeeds in her mission. HQ, out.
HQ_strategic.wav.value_ch: 中士，接管这些坦克，占住标注的三个战略点。这样蒂娜和她的队员就能传送进来，弄清这片区域为何如此重要。务必确保蒂娜完成任务。总部完毕。

Sarge08_01.wav.speaker: Sarge
Sarge08_01.wav.value_en: Men, we need to secure three points inside enemy lines with a tank at each point. With that in mind, lock and load, people.
Sarge08_01.wav.value_ch: 弟兄们，我们要在敌军防线内拿下三个据点，每处配一辆坦克。既然如此，全体上膛，准备战斗。

Sarge10_01.wav.speaker: Sarge
Sarge10_01.wav.value_en: All right, men, wipe those nervous expressions off your plastic faces. We have a job to do.
Sarge10_01.wav.value_ch: 好了弟兄们，把你们塑料脸上那副紧张相给我抹掉。咱们有活要干。

Sarge10_02.wav.speaker: Sarge
Sarge10_02.wav.value_en: You heard the lady. Get to work, soldiers.
Sarge10_02.wav.value_ch: 都听见女士的话了。干活吧，士兵们。

Sarge11_01.wav.speaker: Sarge
Sarge11_01.wav.value_en: It's time to take out the Overlord!

Sarge_AwayInGo1.wav.speaker: Sarge
Sarge_AwayInGo1.wav.value_en: It's a way in. Go, go, go!
Sarge_AwayInGo1.wav.value_ch: 找到入口了，听我号令！冲锋！

Sarge_CommanderMe2.wav.speaker: Sarge
Sarge_CommanderMe2.wav.value_en: There's only room for one commander in this battlefield today, and that's me.
Sarge_CommanderMe2.wav.value_ch: 今天这片战场，只容得下一个指挥官——那就是我。

Sarge_DoOrDie3.wav.speaker: Sarge
Sarge_DoOrDie3.wav.value_en: All the chips are down, boys. Time to do or die.
Sarge_DoOrDie3.wav.value_ch: 筹码全压上了，兄弟们。不是干掉敌人，就是拼到底。

Sarge_FiringSquad1.wav.speaker: Sarge
Sarge_FiringSquad1.wav.value_en: The firing squad is up to something.

Sarge_FoxTrot1.wav.speaker: Sarge
Sarge_FoxTrot1.wav.value_en: We have to get to Foxtrot Whiskey One without losing any civilians. Let's roll out!
Sarge_FoxTrot1.wav.value_ch: 我们必须赶到狐步威士忌目标点，不能丢下一个平民。出发！

Sarge_HowGetThere3.wav.speaker: Sarge
Sarge_HowGetThere3.wav.value_en: How do we get over there?

Sarge_TanLesson3.wav.speaker: Sarge
Sarge_TanLesson3.wav.value_en: Let's teach those Tan a lesson.
Sarge_TanLesson3.wav.value_ch: 让咱们给那帮黄军一个教训。

Sarge_deadOverlord.wav.speaker: Sarge
Sarge_deadOverlord.wav.value_en: That's one dead alien overlord who won't bother us again.
Sarge_deadOverlord.wav.value_ch: 又干掉一个外星霸主，他再也不会来烦我们了。

Sarge_picnicBasket5.wav.speaker: Sarge
Sarge_picnicBasket5.wav.value_ch: 那可不是普通的野餐篮。

SpaceHQ10_04.wav.speaker: SpaceHQ
SpaceHQ10_04.wav.value_en: Commander, we're not picking up any more aliens. It looks like you got them all.
SpaceHQ10_04.wav.value_ch: 指挥官，扫描不到更多外星人了。看来你把它们全收拾干净了。

SpaceHQ_LargeWaves_t.wav.speaker: SpaceHQ
SpaceHQ_LargeWaves_t.wav.value_en: Commander, our scanners indicate large waves of aliens approaching the base from all directions.
SpaceHQ_LargeWaves_t.wav.value_ch: 指挥官，扫描显示大批外星人正从四面八方逼近基地。

SpaceHQ_ReadingsNorth_t.wav.speaker: SpaceHQ
SpaceHQ_ReadingsNorth_t.wav.value_en: Sarge, Tina, this is HQ. Our scanners are picking up some strange reading to the north of your current location. This could be the alien lab we've been looking for. Your mission is to infiltrate the alien lab and upload any useful information about the alien hive from the main computer. HQ out.
SpaceHQ_ReadingsNorth_t.wav.value_ch: 中士、蒂娜，这里是总部。扫描在你们当前位置以北发现异常读数。那可能就是我们一直在找的外星实验室。你们的任务是潜入实验室，从主机里拷取有关外星巢穴的可用情报。总部完毕。

SpaceHQ_ShowAliens_t.wav.speaker: SpaceHQ
SpaceHQ_ShowAliens_t.wav.value_en: Men, let's show these aliens what we're made of.
SpaceHQ_ShowAliens_t.wav.value_ch: 弟兄们，让这些外星人见识见识我们的厉害。

SpaceHQ_chamber.wav.speaker: SpaceHQ
SpaceHQ_chamber.wav.value_en: The aliens are supposed to be led by some sort of overlord. It is said to be in those chambers. Take it out, whatever it is. If this mission fails, all of our efforts will have been for nothing. Good luck, and HQ out.
SpaceHQ_chamber.wav.value_ch: 外星人据说由某个霸主统领，据说它就在那些密室里。不管是什么，除掉它。若此次任务失败，我们所有努力都将付诸东流。祝好运，总部完毕。

Tina08_01.wav.speaker: Tina
Tina08_01.wav.value_en: The portal to our homeworld is inside that black box. You need to get me there so I can open it.
Tina08_01.wav.value_ch: 通往我们母星的传送门就在那个黑匣子里。你得把我送过去，我才能把它打开。

Tina08_02.wav.speaker: Tina
Tina08_02.wav.value_en: We can probably expect some alien resistance on the other side of this portal.
Tina08_02.wav.value_ch: 传送门那头多半会有外星人抵抗。

Tina09_01.wav.speaker: Tina
Tina09_01.wav.value_en: We've just lost contact with an outpost in this sector. We should go there and investigate.
Tina09_01.wav.value_ch: 我们刚和这个星区的一个前哨站失去联络。得过去查一查。

Tina09_02.wav.speaker: Tina
Tina09_02.wav.value_en: The main computer has the data map which contains the location of the alien hive.
Tina09_02.wav.value_ch: 主机里有数据地图，上面标注着外星巢穴的位置。

Tina09_03.wav.speaker: Tina
Tina09_03.wav.value_en: We've got the data map. Let's go.

Tina09_04.wav.speaker: Tina
Tina09_04.wav.value_en: HQ, I'm sending the data map now. We're headed your way.
Tina09_04.wav.value_ch: 总部，我现在把数据地图发过去。我们正往你那边赶。

Tina10_01.wav.speaker: Tina
Tina10_01.wav.value_en: The aliens know we've got the data map. We can expect a full-scale assault.
Tina10_01.wav.value_ch: 外星人知道我们拿到了数据地图。接下来恐怕是全面进攻。

Tina_AlienOverLord.wav.speaker: Tina
Tina_AlienOverLord.wav.value_en: The aliens are reeling from that last assault. Now is our chance to eliminate the alien overlord.
Tina_AlienOverLord.wav.value_ch: 外星人刚被那轮攻势打得晕头转向。现在是干掉外星霸主的好机会。

Tina_CouldUseHelp.wav.speaker: Tina
Tina_CouldUseHelp.wav.value_en: I could use some help here.

Tina_ForceField.wav.speaker: Tina
Tina_ForceField.wav.value_en: I need to rewire their generators so that we can shut down the force field. Help me find those machines so we can get out of here.
Tina_ForceField.wav.value_ch: 我得改装他们的发电机，才能关掉力场。帮我找到那些机器，咱们就能出去了。

Tina_GalacticSoldiers.wav.speaker: Tina
Tina_GalacticSoldiers.wav.value_en: Galactic soldiers, come in. I'm outnumbered and need assistance. I'm in the tunnels beneath their ship. Repeat. Galactic soldiers, come in. I'm outnumbered and need assistance. I'm in the tunnels beneath their ship. Anyone copy?
Tina_GalacticSoldiers.wav.value_ch: 银河战士，收到请回答。我寡不敌众，需要支援。我在他们飞船下方的隧道里。重复，银河战士，收到请回答。我寡不敌众，需要支援。我在飞船下方的隧道里。有人收到吗？

Tina_KeepOff.wav.speaker: Tina
Tina_KeepOff.wav.value_en: Keep those things away from me.

Tina_WayOut.wav.speaker: Tina
Tina_WayOut.wav.value_en: There is a way out of here, but we have to take down the force field generators.
Tina_WayOut.wav.value_ch: 这儿有出路，但咱们得先干掉力场发生器。
